landing.title: serving-explained
landing.description: Interactive explainers of how LLM servers manage GPU memory and schedule requests, run on a small simulated engine in your browser.

kv-cache.title: The KV cache – serving-explained
kv-cache.description: What the KV cache stores, how to estimate its size, and why it limits how many requests fit on a GPU.

paged-attention.title: Paged attention – serving-explained
paged-attention.description: How fixed-size blocks and a block table cut the memory wasted by reserving space for each request.

continuous-batching.title: Continuous batching – serving-explained
continuous-batching.description: How scheduling requests at every step changes waiting time, token latency, and throughput.

prefix-caching.title: Prefix caching – serving-explained
prefix-caching.description: How requests that share a prompt prefix reuse cached KV blocks, and when they cannot.

sandbox.title: Sandbox – serving-explained
sandbox.description: Combine all four mechanisms on a workload, and compare two configurations side by side.

glossary.title: Glossary – serving-explained
glossary.description: Every term the chapters use, defined in one place.
